_readme: §19 click-to-edit: text widgets that render the operator's words but expose
NO hotspot on the canvas ([data-field] / [data-field-jump] / EditableText).
MOUNTS every text-bearing variant AND every bare widget type through the
THIS LIST IS EMPTY AND MUST STAY EMPTY. It was captured at 101 of 239 (42%)
on 2026-09-11 and closed the same day. An unlisted text widget with zero
hotspots fails the suite, so adding an entry here is a deliberate decision to
ship a widget whose words cannot be clicked — it needs a reason saying what
it would take to remove it.
Fixing one is: wrap its operator-owned text in EditableText / [data-field]
(a single string config), or mark the rendered block data-field-jump="<key>"
(a LIST, where typing over the join would destroy every row). Never point a
hotspot at a key the component does not read — that is a silent no-op, and
the sibling check in the same suite fails it.
